title: Epic Landscapes
content: A lot of magazines have been shrinking in size lately, such as theNew York Times magazineandRolling Stone. Even my phone book is tinier than ever.But one magazine,ImagineFX,just got three centimeters taller. And just in time. The topic of issue #69 is Epic Landscapes, with a gorgeous feature on matte painter and concept artistDylan Cole.The magazine comes with a big poster insert and a DVD, too.The painting at left is an early visualization Dylan did as concept art supervisor forAvatar.
